And Another .....Opposite Party(s) Counsel for Applicant(s) : Alok Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party(s) : G.A. Hon'Ble Brij Raj Singh, J. 1. 2. The present application has been filed seeking quashing of the summoning order dated 23.5.2024 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shrawasti along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case no.3631 of 2024 under Sections 18(a)(i), 16 and 27(d) of Drugs and Cosmetic Act, 1940, Police Station Bhinga, District Shrawasti. 3.
texts.facts: 2. The present application has been filed seeking quashing of the summoning order dated 23.5.2024 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shrawasti along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case no.3631 of 2024 under Sections 18(a)(i), 16 and 27(d) of Drugs and Cosmetic Act, 1940, Police Station Bhinga, District Shrawasti. 3.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicants has assailed the impugned order on various grounds including the ground that the summoning order passed by the subordinate court is non speaking. He has submitted that issuing summon is a serious matter in criminal case and the court has to open its mind and record its finding, but in the present case, a bare perusal of the summoning order shows that no such recourse has been adopted by the subordinate court. 4. Learned counsel for the applicants has relied upon the judgment of the Supreme Court in the case of M/s. J.M. Laboratories and others vs. State of Andhra Pradesh and another, 2025 INSC 127, decided on 30.1.2025, which is also pertaining to Drugs and Cosmetic Act, 1940.
